en.headline: Off-duty ambulance officer dies after Kowloon Peak fall
en.dek: Fire Services says one of two off-duty ambulance officers died after a fall while abseiling; his colleague was lightly injured.
body: An off-duty ambulance officer has died after a climbing accident on Kowloon Peak on Friday afternoon, the Fire Services Department said. A second off-duty ambulance officer who was with him was lightly injured and remained conscious.

The department said it received a report at about 2pm that two men were abseiling near Fei Ngo Shan Road when one of them was suspected to have fallen. Firefighters and the Government Flying Service searched the area and found a conscious, lightly injured man near the Ngo Tau trail, and an unconscious man on a nearby cliff.
Both men were brought to a safe position and flown to Eastern Hospital. The man who had been unconscious was confirmed dead after arrival, the department said. It did not release their names.
The Fire Services Department said it was deeply saddened by the death of a member of staff and had sent condolences to his family. Its welfare unit has contacted the family to offer assistance.
Rescuers had earlier been searching the peak after the fall was reported. Friday's rain and thunderstorms were affecting parts of the city while the search was under way.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山墮崖　休班救護總隊目送院不治
zh.dek: 消防處說，兩名休班救護總隊目在飛鵝山遊繩期間一人墮崖，送東區醫院後證實不治，同行者受輕傷。
body: 消防處表示，飛鵝山周五下午發生攀山事故，一名休班救護總隊目墮崖後送院不治，另一名同行的休班救護總隊目受輕傷，當時仍然清醒。
消防處說，下午2時許接報，指兩名男子在飛鵝山道一帶遊繩，其中一人懷疑意外墮崖。消防人員聯同政府飛行服務隊到場搜索，在鵝肚棧道附近尋獲一名清醒、受輕傷的男子，並在附近山崖發現另一名昏迷男子。
消防人員將兩人帶到安全位置，再由飛行服務隊直升機送往東區醫院。昏迷男子抵院後證實不治。消防處沒有公布兩人姓名。
消防處表示，對於有屬員不幸離世感到非常難過，已向家屬致以深切慰問，並安排福利組接觸死者家屬，提供可行協助。
搜救進行期間，本港部分地區仍受驟雨及雷暴影響。較早時消防及飛行服務隊已在飛鵝山展開搜索。
